review_themes.interpretation: Review evidence supports strong design appeal and acceptable everyday functionality, but also contains meaningful durability/quality complaints. The mixed evidence supports REVIEW rather than automatic APPROVE.
review_themes.limitations: The available review sample is small and not a complete statistical analysis of all reviews. Review counts and ratings are volatile and must not be treated as permanent facts.
